title: Trainee, Market Intelligence
description:
**Monotype (Global)**


Named "One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design" by Fast Company, Monotype brings brands to life through type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica,


Futura, Times New Roman and more. Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: design beautiful brand experiences.

 **Monotype Solutions India**  

Monotype Solutions India is a strategic center of excellence for Monotype and is a certified Great Place to Work® three years in a row. The focus of this fast\-growing center spans Product Development, Product Management, Experience Design, User Research, Market Intelligence, Research in areas of Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning, Innovation, Customer Success, Enterprise Business Solutions, and Sales.  

Headquartered in the Boston area of the United States and with offices across 4 continents, Monotype is the world’s leading company in fonts. It’s a trusted partner to the world’s top brands and was named “One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design” by Fast Company.


Monotype brings brands to life through the type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica, Futura, Times New Roman, and more. Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: design beautiful brand experiences.


The associate will perform marketing and technical research into prospective and current customers including, but not limited to, the review of websites, mobile applications, electronic documents, and digital ads. Working closely with Monotype Imaging Inc.’s Legal team, the Research Associate will organize and  

maintain research files and prepare reports documenting issues of infringement or potential licensing gaps for Monotype Imaging Inc.’s and/or its partners’ intellectual property.

**You will have an opportunity to:**

* Conduct brand marketing research.
* Identify digital offerings across all applicable mediums (e.g. mobile applications, websites, digital ads, online marketing materials, etc.)
* Download and review digital assets using a variety of software applications.
* Conduct forensic investigation of IP infringement matters, including technical analysis of hardware and software containing fonts.
* Organize and maintain research files using G\-Suite applications.
* Communicate results with Legal team in a timely fashion.
* Preparation and reporting of statistical data regarding brand font use audits.

**What we are looking for:**

* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS \& JS
* Strong analytical skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft \& Google Office products
* Quick Learner
* Strong communication skills and team player


Monotype is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Dynatrace Administrator
description:
**Req ID:** 370670
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Senior Dynatrace Administrator to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

Role Summary
  
The Senior Dynatrace Administrator is responsible for the end to end administration, optimization, and technical leadership of the Dynatrace observability platform. The role ensures proactive monitoring of application, infrastructure, cloud, and digital experience components, and supports service availability, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across enterprise environments.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Own administration and operational health of the Dynatrace platform, including OneAgent deployment, environment configuration, and access management
* Design and maintain monitoring for APM, infrastructure, cloud services, containers, and digital experience
* Configure and optimize alerting policies, problem detection rules, dashboards, and custom metrics
* Lead platform upgrades, enhancements, and maintenance activities in alignment with change management processes
* Act as an L3 escalation point for complex performance, availability, and observability issues
* Perform deep dive analysis and root cause investigations using Dynatrace AI and analytics
* Integrate Dynatrace with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and other enterprise platforms
* Collaborate with application, network, cloud, SRE, and platform teams to onboard and optimize monitoring for new services
* Drive observability best practices, standardization, and automation improvements
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior administrators and team members
* Develop and maintain SOPs, dashboards, reporting, and operational documentation
* Support service reviews, audits, and leadership reporting related to platform health and performance


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Required Skills Experience
  
* 6–9\+ years of experience in enterprise monitoring, APM, or observability roles
* Strong hands on experience administering Dynatrace (SaaS or Managed)
* Deep understanding of APM concepts, distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and events
* Experience monitoring Java/.NET applications, infrastructure, cloud, and container platforms
* Ability to troubleshoot complex performance and availability issues across full stack
* Strong experience working in enterprise production environments
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes
* Scripting or automation experience (Python, PowerShell, REST APIs)
* Experience with multiple observability tools (AppDynamics, New Relic, Splunk)
* Dynatrace certifications (Associate / Professional)
* Experience supporting DevOps / SRE operating models

title: Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist - PAM (Delinea)
description:
**Req ID:** 386385
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist \- PAM (Delinea) to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Design and Architecture: Lead the architecture, design, and deployment of enterprise\-grade PAM solutions using the Delinea platform (e.g., Secret Server, Privilege Manager, Server Suite) across hybrid environments (on\-premise, cloud, and SaaS).
* Implementation and Configuration: Administer, configure, and maintain Delinea components, including vaulting, session management, account lifecycle management (ALM), and policy enforcement.
* Integration and Automation: Integrate the Delinea solution with Active Directory/Entra ID, LDAP, SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk), ServiceNow, and other identity management systems. Utilize scripting languages (PowerShell, Python) and APIs for automation and operational efficiency.
* Policy and Compliance: Define and enforce security policies, access controls, and workflows to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, ISO, SOX, PCI).
* Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitor the health, performance, and security of the Delinea infrastructure, perform regular health checks, and resolve complex issues related to Delinea components.
* Documentation and Guidance: Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical documentation (SOPs, operational runbooks), and provide guidance and training to application teams and security stakeholders.


Required Qualifications and Skills
  
* Experience:
* Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with substantial hands\-on experience in Delinea PAM implementation and administration.
* Experience with other PAM solutions like CyberArk or BeyondTrust is a plus.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and DevSecOps practices is desirable.
* Technical Skills:
* Deep expertise in Delinea or Centrify components, including agents, Access Manager, Audit components, Secret Server, and Privilege Manager.
* Strong understanding of Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles and Active Directory (AD) integration.
* Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash) and working with REST APIs.
* Familiarity with high\-availability (HA/DR) architecture and enterprise hardening standards.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* Delinea Privilege Manager or Server PAM certification.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, cloud security certifications).
* Soft Skills:
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a high\-pressure environment.

Job Description – Senior Delivery Manager \| BFSI
  
  

**Location:** Noida
  
**Experience:** 15\+ Years
  
**Role:** Senior Delivery Manager / Delivery Leader – BFSI
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Delivery Manager to lead large\-scale technology delivery for a strategic Banking Financial Services (BFSI) client. The role requires strong ownership of end\-to\-end delivery, client relationships, program governance, financial management, people leadership, risk management, and technology transformation.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple BFSI technology programs, ensuring commitments across scope, schedule, quality, budget, and SLAs/KPIs.
* Act as the senior client interface, managing executive stakeholders, governance forums, escalations, delivery reviews, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Lead large, geographically distributed teams across application development, modernization, cloud, DevOps, testing, production support, and AI\-enabled transformation.
* Drive program financials including budgeting, forecasting, revenue/margin management, resource utilization, productivity, and cost optimization.
* Establish strong delivery governance, proactively managing risks, dependencies, issues, change requests, and corrective actions.
* Drive Agile/SAFe delivery, engineering excellence, automation, CI/CD, DevOps, quality improvement, and operational resilience.
* Partner with client and internal teams on solutioning, estimation, SOWs, RFP/RFI responses, transition planning, and account growth opportunities.
* Ensure adherence to BFSI security, regulatory, risk, audit, data privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Build and mentor a strong leadership pipeline across Project Managers, Architects, Engineering Leads, Scrum Masters, and Delivery Leads.
* Drive adoption of GenAI/Agentic AI and AI\-assisted engineering to improve delivery productivity, quality, automation, and operational efficiency.


Required Skills Experience
  
* 15\+ years of IT experience, with significant experience in Delivery/Program Management for large enterprise clients.
* Strong BFSI domain experience across Banking, Payments, Cards, Lending, Insurance, Capital Markets, or Financial Services.
* Proven experience managing large teams (50–100\+), multi\-vendor programs, and global delivery models.
* Strong understanding of cloud (AWS/Azure), microservices, APIs, DevOps/CI\-CD, application modernization, data platforms, and production support.
* Strong commercial skills covering budgeting, estimation, forecasting, utilization, margin, and contract/SOW management.
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, escalation management, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and preferably PMP/CSM/SAFe or equivalent certifications.


Preferred
  
  

Experience leading GenAI/Agentic AI transformation programs, cloud modernization, managed services, and large\-scale transition programs would be advantageous.
